column3: Why did this happen?\nDo you know?{end_now}
I see...{pause_20_skippable} So it's because\nthey hurt the holy tree?{end_wait}
I see...\nNo one could have known.{end_wait}
Who are these people?\nTret's glamour doesn't\ntouch them.{end_wait}
Have they come to save\nthe village with those\nstrange powers?{end_wait}
It won't be enough{pause_20_skippable}\nto save the people\nof Kolima.{end_wait}
They earned this fate.{page_break}Kolima raised axes to\nme. Now I raise mine\nto them!{end_wait}
You children don't know\nthis, but we are{pause_20_skippable} dying.{end_wait}
When we are gone,\nKolima Forest dies with\nus.{end_wait}
We won't die alone,\nLaurel.{page_break}When we go, they go\nwith us!{end_wait}
Tret was once a gentle\nking of the forest.{end_wait}
But he is dying. His\nheart has torn in two...{end_wait}
His wrath turned the\npeople of Kolima into\ntrees.{end_wait}
The gentle Tret no\nlonger speaks.{end_wait}
Hroom!{pause_20_skippable} Kindness invites\ndestruction...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nI need none of it!{end_wait}
To save those he turned\ninto trees,{page_break}you must reawaken his\ngentle side.{end_wait}
But if you cannot stop\nTret from withering,\nwe all will...{end_wait}
Find Tret, deep in\nthe forest.{end_wait}
It's no use, Laurel.{pause_20_skippable}\nHumans can't be trusted!{page_break}I will die, and the\nforest will die with me!{end_wait}
I expected more from you,\n{actor_name:1}...{pause_20_skippable} How can you\ngive up so easily?{end_wait}
It's you...{pause_20_skippable} Soon we all\nwither with Tret.{page_break}The forest is no place\nfor you now. Leave.{end_wait}
Go now... before the\nforest dies.{end_wait}
All in Tret's realm\nanswers to me!{end_wait}
Tret, the forest, Kolima:\nall of it withers with\nme!{end_wait}
You hoped to find my\nkinder self?{end_wait}
Fools!{pause_20_skippable}{page_break}You should never have\ncome. Now you will never\nleave!{end_wait}
Your power shielded you\nin the forest,{page_break}but here you stand in\nthe heart of mine!{end_wait}
Here you will all become\ntrees, and wither with\nthe rest of us!{end_wait}
Was I...{pause_20_skippable} I see...{pause_20_skippable}\nMy heart was nearly\nlost to rage.{end_wait}
I thank you.{pause_20_skippable} I could not\nleave this world with so\nmuch hatred in my heart.{end_wait}
Now I can leave this\nworld without regret.{pause_20_skippable}\nFarewell, warriors.{end_wait}
Why not leave me to die?\nDo you need something\nfrom me?{end_now}
Hroom! I must free them\nbefore they die with the\nforest!{end_wait}
I can't...{pause_20_skippable} My power no\nlonger reaches Kolima...{end_wait}
As you recovered, so did\nour forest...{end_wait}
Fair warning: there's a\nbad sickness going around.{page_break}Keep your hood up and\nyour hands clean.{end_wait}
I don't know you. Are\nyou sure you're not\nlying to me?{end_wait}

{actor_name:4} is a gifted
healer.{page_break}I'm one of her
apprentices. She teaches
me everything.{page_break}She can be stern. But
she means well.{end_wait}
